On Sunscreen Day, we wanted to celebrate differently. ☀️💛

While sunscreen is a part of many of our daily routines, there are countless people who spend hours under the harsh sun without access to even the most basic protection.

So we stepped out to share sunscreen, caps, and water bottles with those who need them the most, because everyone deserves protection, care, and a little kindness.
